title: fix(release): reconcile preview deltas against full history

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The narrow candidate passed twenty actual-script real-Git cases; the baseline passed eighteen controls and reproduced two expected identity gaps. The seventh Lite review timed out before agentic execution and is not convergence. Two repeated optional refactors were rejected with grounded replies and their fork threads resolved without code changes. Matching-version Git source contradicts the bare-SHA header allegation and ordinary default-root omission. A separate supported repository configuration, log.showRoot=false, can suppress root patches despite the existing full-history root-inclusion contract. This conditional path is source-supported but not behaviorally reproduced. An eight-vector baseline/candidate experiment is planned with only an explicit --root change; its runner is being prepared without execution. The root thread remains unresolved, seven review rounds are consumed, and no eighth request was made. Narrow-finding, exact-tree, literal-suggestion and convergence gates remain incomplete.
